CustomField.description: This Value determine TFN and TFN Exemption of the Customer.
CustomField.label: Tax Exemption Type

value.label: NO TFN/TIN - Party opted not to provide a TFN/TIN - Depending on the jurisdiction this is perfectly acceptable/legal. E.g. Australia
CHILD - The party is a minor/child and not required to provide a TFN/TIN
AGE PENSION - Exemption for people on the age service, including veterans and invalid pension.
OTHER GOVERNMENT PENSION - Exemption for people on any other eligible pension or benefit e.g. supporting parent's pension, widow's pension.
TAX EXEMPT - Exemption for entities not required to lodge an income tax return e.g. charities
BANK ORG - The party is recognised as a bank and TFN/TIN is not applicable
NON RESIDENT - The party is a NON RESIDENT of the given jurisdiction
ABN LODGD - The party lodged an Australian Business Number (ABN) in lieu of a TFN/TIN
